slash.name: Slash
slash.desc: Heavy sword sweep — slow, reaching just past the blade.

powerStrike.name: Somersault Smash
powerStrike.desc: Leap into a somersault, then crash down with a heavy ground smash (~2.76× ATK, 0.6s stun) and one forward shockwave (0.642× ATK). Other skills are locked during the flip.

groundSlam.name: Ground Slam
groundSlam.desc: Wind up, then a double somersault into a heavy all-around ground slam — radial AoE (both sides) + triple shockwave ring.

warCry.name: War Cry
warCry.desc: +55% ATK and +25% DEF for 7s — also rallies co-op partners on your map. Battle roar taunts + shock-pulses nearby foes.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.desc: 20 s rage (+30% ATK, +speed) — shared with co-op partners on your map. Casting also restores 20% of your max HP and MP. While active, basic Z attacks launch forward shockwaves.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.desc: +20% DEF + 20% damage reflect for 30s, +2% to both per rank. Rank 5: +10s and +2% DEF; rank 10: +30s and +5% DEF instead. The +DEF also shields co-op partners on your map.

holyShield.name: Holy Shield
holyShield.desc: Ultimate: 2.5s invulnerability + 5s damage reflect. Shares the shield with co-op partners on your map.

warlord_warcry.name: Warlord's Banner
warlord_warcry.desc: 12s banner planted on the field: ATK, heal, and +50% reach on melee swings and area bursts. Rallies co-op partners on your map (War Cry + Bloodlust + heal).

doombringer_apoc.name: Blade of Calamity
doombringer_apoc.desc: Summon a colossal sword: 10 forward cleaves over ~1.4s, with a ground slam midway. Every hit brands foes with DOOM (+2% damage taken per stack, max 10) and stokes Calamity Heat.

crusader_aegis.name: Divine Aegis
crusader_aegis.desc: Heal 60% (co-op partners on your map too) + 5 hovering holy orbs strike nearby foes · HALF damage taken for 9s.

dragoon_skylance.name: Sky Lance
dragoon_skylance.desc: Warp above the nearest foe on screen and dive, punching through one platform — then a second dive re-targets and lands ~0.7s later (only while prey remains). Rank 10 adds a third dive.

warlord_ult.name: War of Banners
warlord_ult.desc: Enter a 10s enrage (Bloodlust, shared with co-op partners on your map) that heals 25% of your max HP and refunds its own MP cost; re-press B for free, rapid banner strikes.

doombringer_ult.name: Calamity Incarnate
doombringer_ult.desc: Name one foe — boss first, else the biggest health pool — and drop the verdict on it: a melee cleave, then SEVEN homing doom-fires that all converge on that single target (~10.3x ATK total, ~12x at full heat). Each fire re-brands with DOOM. Collects up to 10 DOOM brands from the map (from rank 5, each adds +1% execute threshold and +0.4s window) and burns all Calamity Heat (+0.7% damage per point).

crusader_ult.name: Bastion of Dawn
crusader_ult.desc: Tap once to ARM (free), tap again to RELEASE — the cooldown starts at release. While armed the Bastion stores DAWN CHARGE: it grows the longer you hold (full at 10s) and with every point of damage you take (full at one max HP). Release DAWNBREAK: foes are drawn in, then a holy detonation for 8.4× ATK, up to 56× fully charged, in a radius that grows with the charge, plus two wider after-waves — and a full party heal with a 15s half-damage shield for everyone. Armed for 15s, then it erupts on its own.

dragoon_ult.name: Skyfall Dominion
dragoon_ult.desc: Leap skyward and call down 9 dragon-lances that fall on foes within 900px (or rain around you if none), then crash down in a 460px shockwave.

stab.name: Stab
stab.desc: Lightning dagger slash — a quick close arc, the fastest basic attack.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.desc: Blink behind the target + 2-stab crit combo (heavy finisher).

smokeDash.name: Smoke Dash
smokeDash.desc: 3-line dash corridor + 3 smoke ticks. 50% chance to dodge attacks while dashing (no longer fully invulnerable).

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.desc: Blink-warp forward, slashing the corridor — 50% chance to evade attacks while warping. Press again within 6 s to warp back.

shadowStrike.name: Shadow Strike
shadowStrike.desc: Chain-teleport through 5 strikes at 0.898× ATK each — with fewer foes in range, the same ones are struck again.

deathBlossom.name: Death Blossom
deathBlossom.desc: Ultimate: hyper-jump somersault forward, then 3 fast spinning waves. Movement speed + speed cap DOUBLE for the cast.

smokeBomb.name: Shin-Shuriken
smokeBomb.desc: Double somersault — two fans of 5 daggers + 2 shuriken each (3 shuriken at rank 5, 4 at rank 10) that spread out from your chest.

sleight.name: Voidrift Blink
sleight.desc: Assassin V: 3-charge zip across half the screen — tap to blink, hits all foes in the path. Cooldown starts after the 3rd charge.

shadowlord_clones.name: Mirror Shadow
shadowlord_clones.desc: 3 levitating clones flank you at long range — circular AOE strikes for 11s, then SHATTER in a triple shadow nova. While they stand, press again to BLINK to the next clone.

shinobi_seal.name: Kage Rush
shinobi_seal.desc: 4 charges. Each is a short shadow-step slash across a crimson lane — chain them, then the seal recharges.

nightreaper_mark.name: Eclipse Massacre
nightreaper_mark.desc: Blink to the centre of the screen and hover, pinned for the first 1.2 s while a blood-eclipse rains spectral daggers in 10 batches on every enemy under the moon, staggering them. You are free to move for the second half; at 2.5 s the eclipse snaps shut for an aftershock nova and heals 14% max HP. No prey in reach refunds 30 MP instead.

phantom_cut.name: Voidrift Execution
phantom_cut.desc: Mark up to 6 enemies and execute them in 6 chain-teleport strikes (0.67× ATK each); the final hit detonates a stunning shadow nova (0.56× ATK) and restores 15% of your max HP. No prey in reach refunds 30 MP.

shadowlord_ult.name: Shadow Sovereign
shadowlord_ult.desc: Summon your Sovereign Shade: a shadow of yourself that mirrors your every move — run, jump, strike — a beat behind for 20s, and echoes every hit you land as a second strike at 85% damage.

shinobi_ult.name: Hundred-Hand Shadow Dance
shinobi_ult.desc: Four blink-slashes that stick to the nearest foe, then a 5.34× ATK shockwave finale that returns you to where you started.

nightreaper_ult.name: Bloodmoon Domain
nightreaper_ult.desc: Three waves of 9 homing, piercing shuriken, an execute on non-boss foes under 25% HP, then a blood nova. Your next 60 crit rolls are guaranteed.

phantom_ult.name: Voidwalk
phantom_ult.desc: Vault into a void somersault and loose three rings of 12 piercing void shards.

magicBolt.name: Magic Bolt
magicBolt.desc: Arcane projectile (1.4× ATK + 6) that flies straight ~300px. Free to cast.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: Explodes on impact (180 px radius, 70% splash; may ignite).

iceSpike.name: Ice Spike
iceSpike.desc: 3 ice spikes (4 at rank 5, 5 at rank 10); 50% chance to freeze on hit. Rank 10: each spike also pierces 1 foe.

blink.name: Dimensional Warp
blink.desc: Phase across a dimension. Damages every monster in the path traversed (+100×50 px AoE around it). Hold ↑ while casting (or double-tap ↑) to warp skyward.

arcaneBurst.name: Arcane Burst
arcaneBurst.desc: Massive 320-px AoE explosion centred on you.

elemental.name: Elemental Convergence
elemental.desc: Ultimate: lightning chains through up to 8 enemies (12.3× ATK, −8% per hop), stunning each for 1.2s with a 75% chance to burn.

soulSiphon.name: Soul Siphon
soulSiphon.desc: Drain nearby foes (0.484× ATK) into MP and HP, raise 1 undead thrall (skeleton or zombie, 16s) from the first victim, and call up soul orbs (2 to start, +1 every 1.5s, max 5) that orbit you for 12s and hunt — each homes into a foe within 380px and detonates (1.45× ATK).

darkPulse.name: Dark Pulse
darkPulse.desc: Ultimate: void AoE around you (180px, 1.02× ATK), then summon 3 undead that hunt across the map for 30s — each hitting for 55% of your ATK, and killable by monsters.

holyLight.name: Holy Light
holyLight.desc: Self-heal 25–100% maxHP and restore up to 60 MP (both scale with ATK) + holy AoE chip (650×440). +1 Prism Charge (max 5).

celestialAurora.name: Celestial Aurora
celestialAurora.desc: 10s celestial field (550×100) — heals you 15% HP+MP/sec while you stand in it (co-op partners on your map wherever they are), holy DoT to enemies, cleanse on cast. Consumes Prism Charges (+5% per charge).

archbishop_grail.name: Judgment of the Holy Grail
archbishop_grail.desc: Ascend (0.8s guard), rain 7 holy pillars; each hit refunds a little MP.

sage_meteorshower.name: Pyre Columns
sage_meteorshower.desc: Five fire columns erupt from the ground ahead of you in rapid succession - each pillar 6.4x ATK across a 190px lane (weaker at its edges), launching foes skyward.

elementalist_cascade.name: Prismatic Cascade
elementalist_cascade.desc: Four elements in sequence: a Pyre column on the nearest foe ahead (burn), a Frost nova around you (freeze), a Storm chain of up to 4 hops (stun), then the Void convergence - a blast that grows +25% for every element that connected.

necromancer_harvest.name: Soul Vortex
necromancer_harvest.desc: Open a 30s vortex pool that drags enemies in and drains 1.96× ATK/sec (30% returned to you as HP). Recast to move the pool wherever the fight goes.

hexmaster_grandhex.name: Grand Hex
hexmaster_grandhex.desc: Hex everything inside the rune ring: 1.2s freeze (non-boss), a 0.722× ATK burst, and a stacking curse DOT (0.22× ATK/tick per stack) that also makes the target take +4% damage per stack. 1.5s later the ring PULSES AGAIN and stacks EVERYONE inside, so one cast is worth 2 stacks; at 5 it RUPTURES for 2.56× ATK and splashes 40% onto neighbours, infecting them as well. A hexed foe's curse jumps to its nearest neighbour when it dies. Also looses 3 hex orbs (7s) that strike up to 3 times each (2.82× ATK + a stack).

sage_ult.name: Meteor Sigil
sage_ult.desc: Open an 8s sigil: tap B up to 10 times to hurl homing comets (17.5x ATK, explode on impact) at the nearest foes AHEAD of you. Each tap refunds its MP; the cooldown starts when the window closes (10th comet or 8s).

elementalist_ult.name: Elemental Apotheosis
elementalist_ult.desc: Three catastrophes, then the cooldown: each press unleashes one of four random elemental catastrophes - INFERNO (a rolling firestorm that explodes through the pack), GLACIAL CATACLYSM (a comet onto the nearest foe ahead that shatters and freezes), THUNDERFALL (a thunder spear across the whole screen) or SINGULARITY (a slow void sphere that keeps hitting). Three different ones per cast; only the third starts the cooldown. The first strike pays the MP, the other two are free.

necromancer_ult.name: Necrotic Ascendance
necromancer_ult.desc: Become a soul maelstrom for 6s - drag foes in, drain them twice a second (heals you); every soul harvested feeds the final collapse (up to 10.3x ATK). Half damage taken while it storms; with a Soul Vortex open the storm anchors INTO the pool instead of walking with you.

hexmaster_ult.name: Pandemic Hex
hexmaster_ult.desc: Unleash a contagious curse: freeze + WEAKEN (−35% enemy ATK for 9s, bosses included), then a 3s doom that erupts for 2.64×–5× ATK — the deeper the hexes on cursed foes, the bigger. Summons 10 dark hex orbs that hunt, burst, land a hex stack each, and afflict SUPER POISON (0.9× ATK/tick). While the plague runs, a dying foe's curse infects EVERY neighbour in range, not just the nearest.

archbishop_ult.name: Apotheosis
archbishop_ult.desc: 5s of invulnerability and five holy pulses (2.19× ATK, +6% HP each) that build to a 5.05× ATK judgment nova, healing you to full. Co-op partners on your map are healed too.

multiShot.name: Multi Shot
multiShot.desc: 3 arrow spread. Rank 10: each arrow pierces 1 foe.

chargedShot.name: Charged Shot
chargedShot.desc: Big charged arrow — heavy burst; pierces 2 foes (3 at rank 10).

evadeRoll.name: Evade Burst
evadeRoll.desc: Back flip + 2 shot + cute explosive blast that hugely knocks back nearby monsters. 50% chance to evade attacks during the roll.

eagleEye.name: Eagle Eye
eagleEye.desc: +20% crit chance for 30s — also sharpens co-op partners on your map — and a point-blank burst knocks foes in front of you back.

snipe_railgun.name: Railshot
snipe_railgun.desc: Instant piercing rail along the facing direction — hits every foe in a flat line. Each consecutive hit empowers the next. HOLD to overcharge: up to +150% damage and a rail that carries 700 px further.

arrowRain.name: Arrow Rain
arrowRain.desc: Ultimate: Rain arrows over an area.

wildBond.name: Wild Bond
wildBond.desc: Summon a hardy wolf companion. 60s timer OR 15× your max HP, whichever runs out first.

marksman_oneshot.name: Deadeye
marksman_oneshot.desc: FOCUS FIRE — opens a 6s window and locks on to one foe in front of you (bosses first). Every press inside it is free and pours guaranteed-crit lines into that foe, 6.6% ATK each: 3 lines, then 4, 5, 6 and 7 on consecutive presses (pause for 1s and it drops back to 3). Nothing else is hit. The cooldown starts when the window closes.

ballista_volley.name: Siege Volley
ballista_volley.desc: One press unleashes an 8 s piercing arrow stream — other skills are locked while it flows. Drains MP while active and ends early if MP runs out — no holding needed.

beastmaster_pack.name: Call of the Wild
beastmaster_pack.desc: Summon up to 5 oversized wolves (15× your max HP each, 100 s life). Cap is global — re-cast tops up to 5.

skyhunter_gale.name: Gale Storm
skyhunter_gale.desc: 15 homing arrows fanned across, each seeking a foe in range.

marksman_ult.name: Deadeye Protocol
marksman_ult.desc: OVERCLOCK — opens an 8s window and locks on to one foe. Every press inside it is free and fires a volley of 5 homing rounds (7 while Deadeye has that foe marked), 0.6% ATK each, guaranteed crits that hit nothing but the lock. Every 6th volley, and the end of the window, fires an EXECUTE ROUND worth 25% of the volley damage since the last one (at least 0.02x ATK). The cooldown starts when the window closes.

ballista_ult.name: War Machine
ballista_ult.desc: Deploy 1 stationary siege turret that auto-fires homing, piercing arrows at nearby foes for 45 s.

beastmaster_ult.name: Apex Bond
beastmaster_ult.desc: Bond with an apex werewolf companion (~51s) and empower yourself — Bloodlust + a burst of healing, shared with co-op partners on your map.

skyhunter_ult.name: Eye of the Tempest
skyhunter_ult.desc: Summon a storm-eye eagle (~42s) that hovers and fires homing arrows at foes; each arrow pierces twice. The eagle MARKS its prey - every hit on the marked foe strikes +15%.
